O-001.name: Private Investigator
O-001.roleSpecificGuidance: Investigator licensure, permitted activities and access vary by jurisdiction or fictional equivalent. Verify locally applicable authorization; occupation proficiency and equipment do not grant police powers or unrestricted access.

O-005.name: Investigative Journalist
O-005.roleSpecificGuidance: Journalism reference kit centers on documentation, interviewing and evidence capture (EQ-133 camera, EQ-134 voice recorder, EQ-138 notebook). EQ-030 hand saw and EQ-050 utility knife are generic field utility tools, not journalism-specific equipment or prerequisites; GM may omit or replace them with approved documentation equipment, recalculating totals after any change. Primary-skill allocation requires separate occupation-package balance review; inventory guidance does not alter skills or grants.

O-055.name: Physician
O-055.roleSpecificGuidance: Clinical assessment-oriented reference kit. No prescribing, independent practice, facility access, or controlled supplies are conferred by the occupation or kit; verify actual credentials, institutional access, and GM-approved stock.

O-056.name: Surgeon

accessCandidates.reason: Specialist surgical instruments are conditional institutional or GM-approved access only; not automatic personal starting equipment or authority to operate

O-056.roleSpecificGuidance: Portable basic-care reference kit, not an operating theatre or sterile surgical capability. EQ-063 Field surgical kit is a conditional specialist equipment candidate only when credentials, setting access, qualified facilities and GM approval support it; it is not automatically granted, and no surgery authority follows from possession.

O-063.name: Dentist
O-063.roleSpecificGuidance: General portable clinical and utility kit, not a dedicated dental operatory. EQ-030 and EQ-050 are general-purpose tools, not dental instruments. Dental practice requires validated qualifications, suitable specialized instruments, infection control and GM-confirmed facility access.

O-079.name: Community Dentist
O-079.roleSpecificGuidance: Austere community-care kit, not a dental surgery kit. EQ-030 hand saw and EQ-050 utility knife are general-purpose settlement repair/cutting tools, not dental instruments and confer no dental procedure capability. GM may omit or replace these with approved role-appropriate equipment when available; preserve restricted/rare access requirements and recalculate reference totals after any change.
